additional_info.subject: Analysis
additional_info.body:
1.Charger power upgradation document is missing in SCB as per the customer configuration file it is 160 kw LF, but PLC Configuration is set to 300 kw low flex which is fine as charger is detecting all 15 converters.
2. As it is HF there should not be any QA11/12, QA15/16, QA19/20, QA23/24
3.Charger having fast shutdown error, as per log analysis QA11 QA12 showing abnormal operation state, which might be the root cause for missing converter.
4. will reach out to RC to know if hardware changes are done and will also check by debug station via SSH access.
